LanguageData.STB_FeedFromHoppersDesc: If on, this machine takes fuel from a hopper on its intake (the green-marked port) whenever it drops below its target fuel level. Works with the fuel hopper, the vanilla hopper, and Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory hoppers. Turn off to keep a hopper's contents for something else.
LanguageData.STB_PollutesWhileBurning: Pollutes about {0} cells a day while burning
LanguageData.STB_ModeDesc:
What the Stirling engine does with its heat. Click to cycle.

Power: makes its own power.
Turbine feed: sends its heat down a pressurised hot water pipe to a steam turbine instead, worth {0}W there. It makes no power itself.
LanguageData.STB_ModeDescDBH: Water-cooled: draws water from the plumbing to run its cold side cooler, for {0} output while water is flowing.\nHeat recovery: sends its heat into the plumbing as a boiler, for hot water and central heating, at {1} output.
LanguageData.STB_ValveDesc: Open or close this pressurised hot water line.
